newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market steady-firm - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market steady-firm - USDA.

text.p: Live sales compared to Tuesday's close - slaughter steers and heifers were steady to firm, USDA said. Trade was moderate and demand moderate. Seller interest mostly moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs 68.00-68.50. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1250 lbs 68.00.
Carcass basis (weight only) compared Tuesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were uneven, averaging steady.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 110.00 few 111.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs few 104.00-105.00. Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 110.00.
Wk to Date- 7,500 Week Ago - 14,600 Year Ago - 18,300
